description: This file contains utility functions for rendering UI components such as headers, footers, and titles in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes functions for displaying form headers, module titles, and popup headers/footers, relying on global variables, theme registry, and template rendering.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template class used for rendering HTML templates within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: SugarView
classes.description: Represents a generic view context, providing methods for UI rendering such as breadcrumb symbols.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for a form header with optional help, print, and additional text, using Smarty templates.

methods.name: get_module_title
methods.description: Creates a module title section with optional create link, including icon handling and dynamic URL generation.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Constructs a classic view module header with breadcrumb links, icons, and optional create link.

methods.name: insert_popup_header
methods.description: Outputs the HTML head and beginning body tags for a popup interface, including CSS and JS references.

methods.name: insert_popup_footer
methods.description: Outputs closing HTML tags for a popup interface.
